name: Lunar domain exposure API (Webz.io): 12-month aggregate infostealer and breach counts per domain
tier_rationale: Webz.io is an established data company with a business offering and public documentation (docs.webz.io); P136 chair: 'Webz.io is an established company: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Aggregates of infostealer logs and breach/combolist corpora: an exposure context, not the compromise of a specific account; junk and test domains (example.com) show implausible volumes (P136 cond 4).

error_markers.reason: Lunar: rate-limit message in the answer (could not verify)
Lunar: error message inside a 200 answer (could not verify)

domain_exposure.title: Lunar GET /domain-exposure?domain=<domain>: 12-month aggregate counts (events, stealer families, OS, antivirus, months, breach-source split)

terms.quote: Terms 'unknown': the only Webz.io terms found (webz.io/terms, for its free News API Lite) limit data derivatives to non-commercial use and none cover the Lunar endpoint. Disabled in every profile until Webz.io confirms in writing or legal records the terms (A1).

sanitizer.notes: P136 cond 3 / P145: aggregate counts only (12-month totals, stealer families, OS, antivirus, months, breach-source split) survive before the HTTP cache; countries, service classification, per-family shares, top_login_urls (login URL paths can carry masked user names; the core second net drops every key with the token 'login' anyway) and any record-level or future field are dropped.

domain_exposure.notes: Research C0305 (verified_live 200; keyless, unpublished rate limit). A domain asked for the first time answers status GENERATING_REPORT with report null; the report is ready a few seconds later (live check 2026-11-26), so the module polls at most twice more, 3 s apart, and never caches a GENERATING answer. Invalid domains answer HTTP 400 {'error': 'Invalid domain.'}. Results are confidential case data with a minimum marking of TLP:AMBER (P136 cond 5). Cache 24 h (P136 cond 6). Used by lunar_domain_exposure.
domain_exposure.licensed_alternative: Hudson Rock search-by-domain (own domains, also terms unknown) or a licensed infostealer-intelligence feed for own-domain exposure counts.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G04-1 (P136 lunar_domain_exposure). Sensitive provider (A4/P136 cond 3): aggregate fields only, sanitized before the HTTP cache. Terms unknown: default_enabled False (A3 BR2). No published limit: the module adds a politeness budget of 50 lookups per day (daily_quota) and 3 s between requests.
